import json, hashlib, struct, gzip
from pathlib import Path
out = {'scope': 'read-only descriptor and first34 decompressed body bytes; no organism decode'}
env = Path('/proc/1/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\x00')
entry = next((v for v in env if v.startswith(b'GUALA_PAIRED_ROOT=')), None)
if entry is None:
    out['error'] = 'paired root missing'
else:
    root = Path(entry.split(b'=', 1)[1].decode())
    p = root / 'CURRENT'
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    layout = struct.Struct('<8sH36sQ32sQ32sQBQ32sQ32sQ')
    assert len(raw) == layout.size + 32 and hashlib.sha256(raw[:-32]).digest() == raw[-32:]
    v = layout.unpack(raw[:-32])
    assert v[0] == b'GLPAIR02' and v[1] == 2
    out.update(root=str(root), current_mtime_ns=p.stat().st_mtime_ns, current_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), identity=v[2].decode(), tick=v[3], body_sha256=v[4].hex(), body_bytes=v[5], world_sha256=v[6].hex(), world_bytes=v[7], has_predecessor=v[8], predecessor_tick=v[9])
    body = root / 'body-generations' / (v[4].hex() + '.glorun.gz')
    with gzip.open(body, 'rb') as f:
        head = f.read(34)
    out.update(body_file_bytes=body.stat().st_size, body_header_hex=head.hex(), body_magic=head[:8].decode('ascii', errors='replace'))
    if head[:8] == b'GL64ORG1':
        h = struct.unpack('<8sHQQQ', head)
        out['functional64_sections'] = {'version': h[1], 'original_body_bytes': h[2], 'original_world_bytes': h[3], 'native_bytes': h[4]}
    out['descriptor_unchanged_during_read'] = p.read_bytes() == raw
